policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: V launches W-7 for cancer drug crystallization
items.summary: V announced launch of W-7 to study microgravity effects on cancer drug crystallization (PROTAC solubility). A new mission extends its in-space manufacturing evidence pipeline and could de-risk future drug development pathways.

items.headline: O acquires Orchestra Bio
items.summary: O announced acquisition of Orchestra Bio, which coordinates biopharma drug development workflows. This expands O’s drug-development tooling within its Rosalind life-sciences platform.

items.headline: O enterprise roadmap adds GPT-scope partners
items.summary: O published partnership materials expanding how GPT-6 family models are delivered into enterprise workflows (e.g., Atlassian expansion). Such ecosystem updates can support sustained API/app revenue through distribution.

items.headline: O fundraising accelerates ahead of rival IPO
items.summary: Reuters reports O is racing to secure investor commitments before Anthropic’s expected mid-November debut, with possible valuation above $1.4T, citing sources. It also references annualized revenue targets of ~$50B to ~$70B.

items.headline: G Nvidia cloud partnership signals scaling path
items.summary: G’s newsroom previously disclosed becoming an NVIDIA cloud partner (in-market execution continues). For a private watchlist, this supports inference about inference demand availability even without new funding in-window.
